lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits before the pattern becomes less regular toward the caudal region. The first column contains five distinct centroids arranged in a slightly curved vertical line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a semi-regular grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible along the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing surface and distinct shadowing on the ventral-facing surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 14 high-luminance blobs within its silhouette, with a higher spatial density and larger blob size located near the anterior base, transitioning to smaller, sparser spots toward the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region anterior to the gill slits displays a high-density cluster of micro-spots that are significantly smaller and more numerous than the macro-blobs found on the lateral flank.
